description: As community-scale transformation-sharing advances, Francisco discovers Record Keepers weaponizing multi-layer deception as a perception-destroyer designed to create tactical-blindness before decisive-confrontation. Seemingly-natural events—marketplace accidents, Guild disputes, civic emergencies—reveal themselves as orchestrated-misdirections masking systematic reality-edits targeting transformation-infrastructure. The antagonist adaptation exploits surface-acceptance bias, knowing appearances-trust prevents pattern-recognition until strategic-damage accumulates irreversibly. Francisco encounters the Tactical Mirror, an artifact revealing three deception-layers simultaneously: surface-event (what appears to happen), tactical-misdirection (what the deception wants you to believe), and reality-edit (what actually changes beneath attention). Each apparent-accident serves dual-purpose—distracting from real-target while appearing plausibly-random, creating strategic-fog preventing effective-response. The mirror teaches pattern-analysis transcending individual-events: accident-frequency clusters near transformation-hubs, Guild-disputes always involve key-allies, emergencies consistently drain resources needed for decisive-preparation. The choice: accept surface-explanations (which feels reasonable but enables blindness), or engage pattern-detection (which feels paranoid but reveals truth). He chooses tactical-awareness, establishing deception-detection protocol that transforms surface-chaos into strategic-intelligence through misdirection-pattern-recognition, revealing Record Keeper battle-preparation disguised as random-misfortune.

title: The Bias Recognition
setup: Battle tactics: Francisco confronts cognitive-traps where automatic-assumptions create strategic-errors unless he learns bias-awareness, navigating decision-pressure where deliberate-analysis prevents heuristic-failures destroying battle-effectiveness before Record Keeper confrontation-demands exceed reactive-capacity.

preliminarySceneDescription: Battle tactics: Francisco confronts automatic-assumptions creating strategic-errors—deliberate-analysis protocol integration required.
description: As battle-preparation intensifies, Francisco discovers Record Keepers weaponizing cognitive-traps as a judgment-destroyer designed to create strategic-errors through automatic-assumptions that bypass deliberate-analysis. His decisions fall into predictable-patterns—availability-bias preferring recent-memorable over statistically-likely, confirmation-bias seeking evidence supporting preconceptions, anchoring-bias fixating on initial-information despite contradicting-data. The antagonist adaptation exploits System-1-thinking dominance under pressure, knowing heuristic-shortcuts create exploitable-patterns enabling strategic-manipulation. Francisco encounters the Judgment Codex encoding five cognitive-trap categories with counter-protocols: availability-counter (seek base-rates not dramatic-examples), confirmation-counter (actively pursue disconfirming-evidence), anchoring-counter (generate multiple independent-estimates), representativeness-counter (honor statistical-reality over stereotypes), sunk-cost-counter (evaluate future-value ignoring past-investment). Each bias creates specific strategic-vulnerability—availability makes recent-attacks seem more-likely than they are, confirmation prevents recognition of changing-tactics, anchoring locks onto initial-intelligence despite updates. The codex teaches bias-audit discipline: before major-decisions, systematically check all five traps identifying which biases might be active, then apply specific-counters. The choice: trust automatic-judgments (which feel confident but contain systematic-errors), or establish bias-awareness (which feels laborious but enables accuracy). He chooses deliberate-analysis, establishing cognitive-trap-recognition protocol that transforms decision-quality through heuristic-awareness preventing exploitable-patterns Record Keepers manipulate for tactical-advantage.

description: As battle-alliances form, Francisco discovers Record Keepers weaponizing infiltration as a trust-destroyer designed to compromise transformation-network through agents-mimicking-allies creating alliance-paralysis when trust becomes impossible. Some Guild-members exhibit subtle-inconsistencies—familiar-faces with altered-priorities, trusted-allies with changed-communication-patterns, long-term-partners with shifted-behavioral-baselines. The antagonist adaptation exploits blanket-trust assumption, knowing uniform-acceptance enables infiltrator-success until critical-moment-betrayals cascade. Francisco encounters the Veritas Lens teaching behavioral-baseline-analysis: establish normal-pattern for each ally (speech-rhythm, decision-priorities, stress-responses, relationship-patterns), then monitor deviations indicating either genuine-change or replaced-identity. The lens reveals three deception-cue categories: verbal-inconsistencies (story-changes, over-specification, defensive-language), non-verbal-tells (micro-expressions, gesture-changes, proximity-shifts), and pattern-breaks (priority-reversals, relationship-alterations, timeline-contradictions). Each infiltrator creates detectable-signature through baseline-deviation—the challenge is systematic-monitoring without paranoid-paralysis destroying legitimate-trust. The choice: maintain blanket-trust (which feels loyal but enables infiltration), or establish baseline-monitoring (which feels suspicious but enables detection). He chooses behavioral-analysis, establishing deception-cue-protocol that transforms trust-decisions through deviation-recognition preventing infiltration-success while maintaining alliance-capacity through evidence-based-verification not blanket-suspicion.

Francisco discovers the Strategic Synthesis principle encoded in Florence's war-council architecture: true counter-deception emerges when all detection-protocols integrate as unified-awareness where each strengthens the others. The protocols aren't separate-tools but interdependent-elements of complete counter-deception-mastery where integration multiplies effectiveness exponentially. The war-council demonstrates this: North-wall (deception-detection), East-wall (bias-awareness), South-wall (infiltration-detection), Center-chamber (integration-point) where all three converge creating strategic-superiority.
